title: pteris quadriaurita var. argyraea
intro: Pteris quadriaurita var. argyraea, commonly known as the "Five-lobed Brake fern" or " Argyle fern", is a type of fern that belongs to the family Pteridaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, demulcent, and anti-inflammatory effects, which help to soothe and calm the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of Pteris quadriaurita var. argyraea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
